name: Aid For The Refugees
objectiveText: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal. Abandoned Belongings  ( 8 )

comments.body:
If you have the patience of a saint, the boxes @ 59.12, 32.17 and 57.17, 29.30 definitely work every time. 
Respawn time is about 8 minutes. I managed to complete the quest by just camping at these boxes...
replies: I wasn't able t get the box @ 59.12, 32.17 to work, but 57.17, 29.30 worked for me. I appreciate the tip. Also, I was timing it, and the spawn timers were between 2.5 - 5.5 minutes while I was camping the box.

comments.body: Currently is bugged. When clicking on the supplies you'll get the message, "That is already being used". There seem to be 2 locations that spawn supplies that are working though.
replies: Not all of these worked for me, unfortunately.

comments.body:
